records.title: Built and scaled a multi-country enterprise PMO
records.role: PMO Section Head (Project Management Department Manager)

source_evidence.claim: Built and led enterprise PMO from ground up managing 300+ concurrent banking, insurance, and payments projects across 8 countries.
Recruited and trained 16 Project Managers and implemented a directive PMO framework with KPI-driven reporting and standardized delivery methodology.

source_evidence.locator: Professional Experience > Network International > bullets 2 and 4
source_evidence.claim: The portfolio served 300+ banking and financial services clients and included mobile wallets, cardless transactions, and cross-border money transfer solutions.

records.situation: Network International operated a large banking, insurance, and payments portfolio across eight countries and needed a consistent enterprise delivery model.
records.responsibility: Ahmed was responsible for building and leading the enterprise PMO and its project-management capability.
actions: Built the enterprise PMO from the ground up.
Recruited and trained a team of 16 Project Managers.
Introduced a directive governance model, KPI-driven reporting, and a standardized delivery methodology.
Governed a portfolio spanning banking, insurance, payments, and mobile-commerce solutions.

outcomes.statement: The PMO governed 300+ concurrent projects across eight countries.
The governance model supported a portfolio serving 300+ banking and financial services clients.

story_angles: A PMO is scalable only when governance reduces dependence on individual memory.
Portfolio control at scale requires decision rules, not merely more reporting.
Building the management system and the management team are the same transformation.
questions_to_complete: What specific portfolio problem or failure pattern triggered the decision to build the PMO?
Which governance intervention made the largest measurable difference?
What delivery, financial, or client outcome can be supported beyond portfolio scope?

constraints: Do not add delivery-rate, savings, revenue, or quality percentages without Ahmed's confirmation.

records.situation: Network International needed one enterprise Salesforce implementation to support CRM, service management, and client engagement across a geographically distributed operation.
records.responsibility: Ahmed governed the multi-country implementation over its 14-month delivery period.
actions: Governed the enterprise implementation across eight countries.
Coordinated a rollout covering CRM, service management, and client engagement.
Managed the implementation within the wider enterprise PMO and banking-client environment.

outcomes.statement: The full Salesforce platform rollout covered eight countries and 170 users across an environment serving 300+ banking clients.

scope_metrics.label: Banking clients in the operating environment

story_angles: One platform rollout across eight countries is eight adoption environments, not one transformation.

records.title: Led product and operating discipline during Talabat hypergrowth

source_evidence.locator: Professional Experience > Delivery Hero SE (Talabat) > bullet 1
source_evidence.claim: Led product strategy and operational improvements during hypergrowth, contributing to platform scaling from 30,000 to 7 million daily orders across GCC markets.

source_evidence.locator: Professional Experience > Delivery Hero SE (Talabat) > bullets 2-4
source_evidence.claim: Drove feature prioritization, led the Operations Excellence Committee across Berlin HQ and regional markets, established KPIs and dashboards, and managed cross-functional product and design teams using lean methods.

records.responsibility: Ahmed led product strategy and operational-improvement work, including regional coordination, KPI discipline, and feature prioritization.
actions: Drove product direction and feature prioritization for rapidly scaling logistics operations.
Led an Operations Excellence Committee connecting Berlin headquarters, GCC countries, and Egypt markets.
Established KPIs and performance dashboards.
Applied lean methods and led cross-functional product and design teams.

outcomes.statement: During Ahmed's product leadership tenure, the platform scaled from 30,000 to 7 million daily orders across GCC markets.

scope_metrics.label: Growth multiple stated in master CV

story_angles: During hypergrowth, operating assumptions can fail before the platform does.
Product prioritization at scale is a trade-off system, not a feature list.
Regional operating discipline connects global product intent with local market reality.
questions_to_complete: Which specific product or operating decision had the clearest measurable effect?
